facts: Four teacher modes retain identical student heads and common AR/direction objectives.
Active teacher arms share a total auxiliary objective weight of 0.6 by default; dual divides this budget between CZSC and ICT.
Zero-weight objectives are excluded from the autograd total so inactive teacher heads retain None gradients and avoid AdamW weight decay.
Tune direction LogLoss alone selects checkpoints, including the initialized step-zero candidate.
Training records initialization and consumed-sample-order hashes, initial/final/selected train-only diagnostics, shared-LoRA gradient cosines and parameter movement.
Evaluation records masked teacher reconstruction metrics against train-fitted constant baselines, direction confusion and per-row LogLoss.
Synthetic checks do not start an optimizer loop, load real assets, access external data, or promote models.
